# Jacob Chademwiri

> Tender & Project Manager, Web Developer based in Centurion, Gauteng, South Africa.
> Specialised in tender management, ISO/SHEQ compliance systems, project delivery coordination, and high-performance web development (React, Next.js, Astro).

## Core Capabilities
- **Tender Management**: Full lifecycle management, RFP/bid document analysis, compliance scheduling, CSD/CIDB compliance, and competitive bid compilation for municipalities, SOEs, and commercial clients.
- **Project Management**: Agile delivery coordination, timeline and budget governance, stakeholder management, and Microsoft 365 / Sage Accounting tracking.
- **Web Development**: Modern, accessible, and fast websites and web applications built with Next.js, Astro, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
